REPORT ON Chinese Labourers' Association, 559 Poo Ching Li,
Broadway East

Made by D.S. Quayle Forwarded by L. J. O'Conor

Sir,

I herewith beg to forward a report of the activities of
the Chinese Labourers' Association which has its office at
559 Poo Ching Li, Broadway East, and which was formed 1.5.22.
Attached is a draft of the regulations governing the
Society with a rough translation of same, also a member's card.
I was able to obtain access to the books of the
Association and according to these the total membership is
slightly over 700 persons.
Of these 700 about 500 are employees of the Nanyang
Tobacco Company and included in this number are some 40 or
50 women members. The employment of the other members of
the Association varies. There are ships firemen, shop
assistants, metal workers, etc. and also three tramway
conductors. I believe the number of tramway conductors
✓ enumerated on the books is fictitious. From enquiries I
have made it would appear that some 30 or 40 tramway
conductors all from the Wayside Car Sheds are members. .
Their names have not been entered in the books either because
they have not paid their subscriptions or because of some
other reason which I have not been able to ascertain.
Conductor No.317 is the leader of the Tramway Company's men
and not No.315 as stated in the attached letter from Mr.
Herbert. With him are associated Conductors Nos. 250 and
400. These are the original tramway members of the Society
and other tramway members who have joined must have been
invited to do so by one of these men. Whilst on the subject

关于中国劳工协会的报告，百老汇东路轴庆里559号，

由 D.S. Quayle 制作，由 L. J. O'Conor 转呈

先生：

兹呈上关于中国劳工协会活动的报告，该协会办事处位于百老汇东路轴庆里559号，成立于1922年5月1日。随函附上该协会章程草案及其粗略译文，以及一张会员证。
我得以查阅该协会的账簿，根据账簿显示，总会员人数略超过700人。
在这700人中，约500人是南洋烟草公司的员工，其中包括约40或50名女性会员。协会其他成员的就业情况各异。有轮船司炉、店员、金属工人等，还有三名电车售票员。我认为账簿上列出的电车售票员人数是虚构的。根据我的调查，似乎约有30或40名电车售票员都是来自路边车棚的成员。他们的名字未录入账簿，要么是因为他们未缴纳会费，要么是出于其他我未能查明的原因。
售票员第317号是电车公司员工的领袖，而非赫伯特先生附件信中所述的第315号。与他有关联的是售票员第250号和400号。这些是该协会最初的电车成员，其他加入的电车成员必然是受这些人之一邀请而入会的。就此话题而言

of the letter from the Tramway Company I beg to state that no meeting was held on Saturday. I also beg to add that my enquiries have been made exceedingly difficult owing to the fact that the Company stationed two of their Chinese Inspectors in the Poo Ching Li alleyway to take the numbers of the conductors who frequented the Association's premises. The reason for their presence was obvious the result being tramway employees have given the premises a wide berth during the past few days.
It is, however, fairly certain that Conductors Nos. 267, 334, 265, 378 and 306 are also members.
The Association has one room on the groundfloor of 559 Poo Ching Li. This room is fitted up with a long table (on which are various current periodicals), surrounded by a number of chairs. Whilst there are benches around the walls of the room. At one end of the room is a rostrum from which speeches are delivered and over this rostrum is a large photograph of Sun Yat Sen.
There are no branch offices. There is a committee of 21, of which 19 are Cantonese and of this committee 20 are employed at the Nanyang Company. This committee is due to meet at 7 to 7.30 p.m. every Sunday but has not done so for some time past. A monthly magazine is supposed to be run by the Association but it has not appeared for some time. According to discussions I have had with various members of the committee the objects of the Association are quite innocuous. This would also appear

电车公司的来信，我要说明的是，周六并未举行会议。我还要补充说，由于公司在轴庆里弄堂派驻了两名华籍督察，记录经常光顾协会场所的售票员号码，使得我的调查变得极其困难。他们出现的原因显而易见，结果是过去几天电车员工都对该场所避而远之。
不过，可以相当肯定的是，售票员第267、334、265、378和306号也是会员。
该协会在轴庆里559号的一楼有一个房间。房间里配备了一张长桌（上面放着各种当期期刊），周围摆放着许多椅子。房间四周还有长凳。房间的一端有一个讲台，用于发表演讲，讲台上方悬挂着一幅孙中山的大幅照片。
没有分支机构。有一个由21人组成的委员会，其中19人是广东人，而这21人中有20人在南洋公司任职。该委员会定于每周日晚7点至7点半开会，但已有一段时间未开会了。协会 supposed to 出版一份月刊，但已有一段时间未出现了。根据我与委员会各位成员的讨论，该协会的目标是完全无害的。这也似乎

to be so from the list of regulations, but I believe that the
main object is to form a union of Nanyang employees.
The authorities at Nanyang's are also aware of this and
I am given to understand that they have offered $2,000 to
break up the Association and also offered the use of a large
house at the corner of East Seward and Chaoufoong Roads as
a place of recreation for their employees.
The brains behind the organisation are Woo Tsung Ming
(何中民) and Kwan King Sung (關民生) both Cantonese employed
by the Nanyang Tobacco Company. The former is the Inspector
of workers in the factory and the latter is head of the
factory general office.
From information that has reached me it would appear that
there is a great deal of friction between the staff and the
management of Nanyang going on at present, and I think that
the association is being formed by the staff in order to get
the combined support of the workers on their side when the
ultimate clash between these two parties takes place.
Further enquiries as to Tramway members of the Association
are proceeding.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
D.S. 196.

从章程列表来看也是如此，但我认为其主要目的是组建一个南洋员工工会。
南洋方面的当局也意识到了这一点，据我了解，他们已出价2,000美元以瓦解该协会，并提议将东熙华德路与兆丰路拐角处的一所大房子用作其员工的娱乐场所。
该组织背后的智囊是何中民 (Woo Tsung Ming) 和關民生 (Kwan King Sung)，两人均为受雇于南洋烟草公司的广东人。前者是工厂的工人督察，后者是工厂总办事处的负责人。
根据我所获得的信息，目前南洋公司的职员与管理层之间存在大量摩擦，我认为该协会是由职员组建的，以便在这两方最终发生冲突时获得工人的联合支持。
关于协会中电车成员的进一步调查正在进行中。
先生，
您忠实的仆人，
D.S. 196.
刑事情报处处长。
随函附上该协会5月、6月、7月和8月的杂志样本。

4831
11/11/22
Rough draft of Regulations of Chinese Labourers' Association.

Address: Poo Ching Li alleyway, Broadway East.
Legal Advisor: Mr. Goldring.
------------------

1. Name: Chinese Labourers' Association.
2. Objects:
   (a) To uplift the standing of labourer in society.
   (b) To maintain the safety of labourers' livelihood.
   (c) To promote social happiness by the influence of mutual help.
3. Responsibilities of the Association:
   (a) Education. Establishing labourers' schools, publishing
       labourers' magazines etc., delivering speeches, and
       furnishing newspapers and books and reading places
       for labourers.
   (b) Means of livelihood. This Association will introduce
       free of charge members to fulfil positions of experts
       of any kind, engineers or any other workers.
   (c) Public entertainments. Establishing labourers' bath
       houses, restaurants and places of amusement.
   (d) Judicature. To judge and settle disputes or fighting
       between members.
   (e) Communications. To reply to enquiries on any questions
       concerning this Association or on any matters done by
       this Association on behalf of members.
   (f) Investigation. To study the present condition of labourers'
       livelihood, the total number of labourers and number of
       unemployed.
4. Entry is open for all classes of Chinese male and female workers.
5. Entry is accepted on introduction of at least one member or the
   executive committee of the Association, an application duly
   signed will be exchanged for a member's certificate.

译文。
4831
1922年11月11日
中国劳工协会章程草案。

地址：百老汇东路轴庆里弄堂。
法律顾问：Goldring 先生。
------------------

1. 名称：中国劳工协会。
2. 宗旨：
   (a) 提高劳工在社会中的地位。
   (b) 维持劳工生计的安全。
   (c) 通过互助的影响促进社会幸福。
3. 协会的职责：
   (a) 教育。建立劳工学校，出版
       劳工杂志等，发表演讲，并为
       劳工提供报纸、书籍和阅读场所。
   (b) 生计手段。本协会将免费介绍
       会员担任各类专家、工程师或其他
       工人的职位。
   (c) 公共娱乐。建立劳工浴室、餐馆
       和娱乐场所。
   (d) 司法。裁决和解决会员之间的纠纷
       或斗殴。
   (e) 通讯。回复关于本协会的任何问题
       或本协会代表会员所办事项的咨询。
   (f) 调查。研究劳工生计的现状、劳工
       总数及失业人数。
4. 所有阶层的中国男女工人都可加入。
5. 经至少一名会员或协会执行委员会介绍，
   签署正式的申请表即可换取会员证。

page_data.en:
6. Entrance fee 60 cents; annual fee $2. payable half-yearly.
   Special contribution is also accepted.
7. Due protection to this Association is to be given by every
   member.
8. All members alike may enjoy the privileges of this Association.
9. Staff. Board of Directors and Executive Committee, consisting
   of secretary, treasurer, auditor, etc., etc.
10. Duties of above will be specified separately.
11. A chief will take charge of each of the two boards.
12. Staff will be elected at the mass meeting of members.
13. Tenure of office. Director 1 year; Executive Committee 3 years.
14. They will be held fully responsible for their duties.
15. They are not allowed to exercise their powers on private accounts.
16. This Association holds no responsibility for their personal
    conduct.
17. Any improper acts having been found to have been committed
    by any one of the staff, which being considered as prejudical
    to this Association the Chief of the Executive Committee
    has the right to cancel his position and membership.
18. For extraordinary cause, resignation of any of the staff can
    be accepted at the sanction of the Board of Directors.
19. A man who has retired still holds responsibility for any
    irregularity that may be discovered on any matters dealt
    with by him during his tenure of office.
20. They receive no pay, until this Association is well financed.
    Allowance for their expenses will then be granted.
21. Meetings: Usual mass meeting, provisional mass meeting,
    meeting of the Board of Directors or of the Executive
    Committee and joint meeting of the two boards.
22. Condition of meetings: A quorum will consist of half the
    members, and resolutions passed at 2/3 of the total votes
    present.
page_data.zh:
6. 入会费60分；年费2美元，每半年支付一次。
   也接受特别捐款。
7. 每位会员都应给予本协会应有的保护。
8. 所有会员均享有本协会的特权。
9. 职员。董事会和执行委员会，包括秘书、
   司库、审计员等。
10. 上述人员的职责将另行规定。
11. 两个委员会各由一名主席负责。
12. 职员将在会员大会上选举产生。
13. 任期。董事1年；执行委员会3年。
14. 他们将对各自的职责负全部责任。
15. 不允许他们因私事行使权力。
16. 本协会不对他们的个人行为承担责任。
17. 如果发现任何职员有不当行为，且被认为
    对本协会有害，执行委员会主席有权撤销
    其职务和会员资格。
18. 如有特殊原因，经董事会批准，可接受任
    何职员的辞职。
19. 退休人员在任职期间处理的事务中若发现
    任何违规行为，仍须承担责任。
20. 在本协会资金充足之前，他们不领取薪水。
    届时将发放费用津贴。
21. 会议：常规会员大会、临时会员大会、
    董事会或执行委员会会议以及两个委员会
    的联席会议。
22. 会议条件：法定人数为会员的一半，决议
    需经出席总票数的三分之二通过。

24. Revision of the above rough regulations will be effected at the

25. Detailed regulations will be drafted by the Board of Directors

SHANGHAI 2nd November, 1922

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.
Local.

Dear Sir,

I am informed that an endeavour is being
made to form some sort of union or association among our
employees, and I have learnt this morning that about 100
of our conductors have joined an organisation which has its
head quarters at No.559 Foo Ching Lee, Broadway East. The
information given me is to the effect, that this is a social
club for Chinese labourers where they can meet together, and
if necessary open discussions regarding their employment.
The entrance fee is $1.60 with an annual subscription of $2.00.
As far as I can make out, the leader of
our men is Conductor No.315. It is understood that a large
meeting has been called for Saturday, to which our men have
been specially invited.

亲爱的先生：

我获悉有人试图在我们的员工中组建某种工会或协会，我今天上午得知，我们约有100名售票员加入了一个组织，其总部设在百老汇东路 Foo Ching Lee 559号。提供给我的信息表明，这是一个为中国劳工设立的社交俱乐部，他们可以在那里聚会，并在必要时就就业问题进行公开讨论。入会费为1.60美元，年费为2.00美元。
据我了解，我们员工的领袖是售票员第315号。据悉，周六将召开一次大型会议，我们的员工已被特别邀请参加。
